# Ottavada

> Ottavada is a free, open source desktop application for Windows 10 and 11 that organizes, syncs and protects the sheet music repertoire of orchestras, bands and institutions across multiple computers — using Google Drive or Koofr as a free cloud bridge. No subscription, no proprietary server, no data collection.

The official site is available in 6 languages: Portuguese (Brazil), English, Spanish, French, Italian and German. Ottavada is in early development but receives frequent updates based on user feedback.

## Key features

- Smart folder indexing: point Ottavada at a folder and it auto-suggests song and instrument names from filenames
- No duplicates: the system blocks identical song or instrument names in the same scope
- Smart search and filters by name, category, composer, arranger
- Standard Orchestral Score Order (woodwinds, brass, percussion, keyboards, strings) automatically applied
- Two usage modes in one app: Conductor computer (full control) and Rehearsal computer (read-only, zero risk)
- Free cloud sync via Google Drive or Koofr — files are compressed before upload
- Works with the tools musicians already use: Finale, MuseScore, Sibelius, Dorico, plus PDF, MusicXML and MIDI files
- Local copies on every computer — works offline during rehearsal, no cloud dependency at the critical moment
- 1-click restore: format a PC or buy a new one and the entire repertoire comes back in the original folders
- No file renaming, no proprietary formats, no lock-in — uninstalling leaves files untouched
- 6 languages: pt-BR, en, es, fr, it, de
- 100% free, no subscription, no ads, no limit on pieces
- Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/Faell4328/ottavada

## How it works (short)

1. Install on a "Conductor computer" (admin) and one or more "Rehearsal computers" (read-only)
2. On the Conductor, point Ottavada at a folder of sheet music — it indexes songs and instruments from the folder/file naming pattern
3. Click the sync icon to send changes to the cloud (Google Drive or Koofr)
4. On each Rehearsal computer, click sync to pull the latest repertoire
5. The Conductor controls per-piece and per-score status (send allowed, send not allowed, ignored)

## Limitations (intentional)

- Only one Conductor computer can sync at a time. Multiple Rehearsal computers are unlimited.
- No central server — cloud sync uses the user's own Google Drive or Koofr account.
- Currently Windows 10 and 11 only.
